chunks: And Imam al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said:
Regarding the saying of Allah, the Exalted: 'By those who distribute commands'
He said: 'The angels distribute the sustenance of the children of Adam from the rising of dawn until the rising of the sun. Therefore, whoever sleeps during this period sleeps away their sustenance.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of sleeping between dawn and sunrise according to Imam al-Ridha?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ridha (as) interprets the 'distributors' in Surah Adh-Dhariyat as angels who allocate sustenance between dawn and sunrise, a concept rooted in Shia exegetical tradition linking celestial activity to daily provision. This narration underscores the practical spiritual discipline of avoiding sleep immediately after Fajr prayer, emphasizing that negligence during this window results in missing one's divinely appointed rizq.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1450 - Imam al-Ridha (as) said regarding the verse of Allah (swt), the Exalted: "By those who distribute commands"
He (Imam (as)) explained: "The angels distribute the sustenance of the children of Adam from the time of dawn until sunrise. Therefore, whoever sleeps during this period sleeps away their sustenance."
